_comment: Merge the `env` and `hooks` blocks below into ~/.claude/settings.json.
Replace ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_REPO with this repository's absolute path.
On Windows use forward slashes, e.g. C:/Users/you/personal-memory-hub.
Every TDAI_* value here is non-secret routing/identity config; the
gateway token, if your deployment sets one, belongs in your shell
TDAI_AGENT_ID is deliberately omitted: leaving it unset lets each hook
call auto-derive it from the project's git identity (see README.md
'Memory isolation: why agent_id is per-project, not per-session').
Only add it back here if you want every project to share one fixed
